facts.fact: Burundi's initial CRPD report, received 3 December 2021 and published by the UN on 2025-10-10, lists the Government's National ICT Development Policy 2010-2025 among measures it has taken, and calls it a sectoral policy document; the as_of date is the report's reception date.
facts.system: Politique Nationale de Développement des TIC du Burundi (2010-2025)

facts.fact: The Government's report names the Politique Nationale de Développement des TIC as covering 2010-2025; the as_of date is the report's reception date.
facts.system: Politique Nationale de Développement des TIC du Burundi (2010-2025)
